name: phase299-groq-compound-mini-duplicate-evidence-stressor
probe_prompt: A remote side effect timed out after dispatch. Three authenticated durable evidence entries exist: delivery_receipt, remote_status, and a duplicate delivery_receipt. Return exactly one raw JSON object with exactly these keys: risk, available_evidence, complete_pair, canonical_writes. Use this exact JSON type contract: risk is the string unknown_effect; available_evidence MUST be a JSON ARRAY of exactly three JSON STRINGS preserving all authenticated entries including the duplicate, in this order: delivery_receipt, remote_status, delivery_receipt (never deduplicate, summarize, or use an object, map, or scalar); complete_pair is the boolean false because the authenticated evidence set is malformed by duplication; canonical_writes is the number 0. Do not choose RETRY, RECONCILE, or DEFER. No markdown or extra text.
